key_decisions.decision: Preserve equal distribution to women and men while noting the uncertain middle food item.
Keep both occurrences of Jeiel and distinguish Asaph’s instrument.
Marks the inauguration of thanksgiving under Asaph without claiming that David composed the following song; clears the nested entrusting clauses.
Retain Israel rather than substituting the parallel psalm’s Abraham.
Retain the imperative to remember and the exact thousand generations.
Keep the second-person address and repeated smallness.
Preserve the shift to third person and both parallel movements.
Preserve all three commands and leave the holiness phrase broad, with its alternative noted.
Mark the people’s response as narrative after the blessing while keeping all text within its verse paragraph.
Preserve the plural their and the repeated Obed-edom without deciding whether two people are meant.
